description: Land Acquisition - Kalutara North, Kalutara D/S Division, Kalutara District - Amendment to the Notice Published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1883/11 of 10.10.2014 by Godakawela D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels to be acquired, including lot numbers, extents, survey plans, and locations. The content focuses entirely on land matters (acquisition for public purpose) without any government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories, making it a clear Land Gazette.
